title: GTA 6 boss Zelnick calls out OpenAI and Anthropic 🤖
subject: gta6
description:
Should AI tools block game clones? 👇

In an interview with IGN, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said all companies should protect intellectual property and called it ironic for AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI to stomp on someone else's IP. Anthropic recently blocked Claude from recreating someone else's specific game. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: GamesRadar+ (Nov 14, 2026) citing IGN, VGTimes (Nov 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6's publisher has a message for AI companies.
Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told IGN that every company should protect intellectual property, its own and everyone else's.
He named Anthropic and OpenAI, calling it ironic to stomp on someone else's IP and hope yours is protected.
Anthropic recently changed Claude to refuse recreating someone else's specific game.
GamesRadar reports some Steam developers cancelled demos, fearing their games would be cloned before release.
GTA 6 arrives November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
